//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the prop-card CONTAINER — the bordered `.pa-prop-card` block (keen `DataDisplay.prop_card/1`, svelte `display/PropCard.svelte`). SCOPE = CONTAINER ONLY. The rows (`pa-prop-card__row` / `__label` / `__value` / `__value--bold` / `__copy` + the `__row--copy-*` interaction modifiers) come from a SEPARATE sub-component (keen `prop_card_row/1`, svelte `PropCardRow.svelte`) handed to the container through its default slot. Both dumpers pass slots as PLAIN ESCAPED TEXT, so that row markup can't flow through — the body is a bare text token. This fixture proves ONLY what the container itself emits: its `<div class="pa-prop-card">` shell, the optional `pa-prop-card__header` it renders from a title prop, class passthrough, and that the body slot lands inside. The row element classes are listed in `deferred` as acknowledged prose (they are the row sub-component's contract, covered by each wrapper's own prop_card_row / PropCardRow unit tests, not this container slice).

propsVocabulary.header: card header title — rendered as pa-prop-card__header only when present (keen `header`, svelte `headerText`)
propsVocabulary.body: the card's row area — filled with plain slot text in this container-only slice (real pa-prop-card__row children are the deferred sub-slice fed via the default slot). keen's inner_block is required:true so every scenario supplies it
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim (svelte `class`, keen `class`) — class passthrough, not a core feature

goldenConventions: Structural only — the prop-card container adds no attribute conventions (unlike button's type). The body slot is a plain text token (Body) so the diff checks the container's tag + class + the header element + nesting, not rich row content. The header is emitted ONLY when a title is supplied (both wrappers gate it with :if / {#if}). Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away, so goldens are written for readability.

features.//: Feature->class contract authored from dist/css/main.css. The .pa-prop-card BLOCK has ZERO block-level modifiers (no pa-prop-card--* exists — grep '\.pa-prop-card--' on main.css is empty; the --copy-* modifiers are ELEMENT modifiers on __row, part of the deferred row sub-component). So the container contract is minimal: the base class, an optional header title, a body slot, and a class passthrough. capability.mjs axis-1 block-modifier reverse-check is therefore vacuous for this block; __header is verified forward via the header scenarios, and the per-row __element classes are deferred as prose.

header.note: card header; only emitted when a title is supplied

body.note: structural — the container's inner content; row structure is the deferred sub-slice

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

deferred.//: Per-ROW element classes of the pa-prop-card block — NOT container markup. They come from the row sub-component (keen prop_card_row/1, svelte PropCardRow.svelte) handed to the container through its default slot, which both dumpers render as plain escaped text, so they can't appear in this container-only slice. There is no separate prop-card-row FIXTURE, so these are acknowledged PROSE (not verified fixture refs). The copyable `__copy` element and the `__row--copy-btn/-click/-hover` modifiers are the row's clipboard-interaction markup (svelte PropCardRow emits them when copyMode is set; keen prop_card_row has no copy support) and live on the row, likewise out of this scope. All are covered by each wrapper's own row unit tests.
deferred.pa-prop-card__row: row sub-component (prop_card_row / PropCardRow) — fed via the default slot, out of container scope
deferred.pa-prop-card__label: row sub-component element — out of container scope
deferred.pa-prop-card__value: row sub-component element — out of container scope
deferred.pa-prop-card__value--bold: row sub-component per-row author flag (keen is_bold, svelte isBold) — out of container scope
deferred.pa-prop-card__copy: row sub-component clipboard button (svelte PropCardRow copyMode) — out of container scope
deferred.pa-prop-card__row--copy-btn: row copy-interaction modifier (svelte copyMode=btn) — out of container scope
deferred.pa-prop-card__row--copy-click: row copy-interaction modifier (svelte copyMode=click) — out of container scope
deferred.pa-prop-card__row--copy-hover: row copy-interaction modifier (svelte copyMode=hover) — out of container scope

scenarios.name: basic
scenarios.note: The blessed default container: a <div class="pa-prop-card"> with an uppercase header element then the row body. Both wrappers emit the same shell.

scenarios.name: no-header
scenarios.note: No header title -> the pa-prop-card__header element is omitted entirely (both wrappers gate it).

scenarios.name: extra-class
scenarios.note: Class passthrough — the extra class is appended after pa-prop-card; token order is normalized away.

scenarios.note: Empty body still emits the shell + header -> proves the wrapper never omits or wraps the container.
